retrievalProfile.description: A group portrait presented as a framed masterpiece in a gallery, viewed by silhouetted spectators to create a sense of legacy and scale.
triggerTerms: monumental group photo in gold frame
excludeWhen: naturalistic outdoor lighting without framing is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A large-scale group portrait set against an iconic urban bridge, encased in an ornate gold museum frame and viewed from behind by a crowd of silhouetted observers in a dark gallery space.
coreVisualRelationships: The ornate gold frame acts as a portal between the dark gallery and the bright urban scene.
Silhouetted foreground figures provide a sense of scale and voyeurism.
The central figure in the portrait serves as the primary focal point through color contrast.
The suspension bridge lines lead the eye toward the group's heads.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black silhouettes in the bottom foreground
Low-angle perspective on the main subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group is centered within the frame, occupying the middle ground at a medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a bright teal shirt provides the strongest color anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the silhouetted heads at the bottom, up to the central figure, then following the bridge cables outward to the rest of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark gallery space at the bottom and the sky within the frame provide breathing room for the busy central composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows in the gallery foreground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic gold of the frame against the dark surroundings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant teal and red clothing on the central subjects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and saturation within the 'painting' area, contrasting with zero-detail black silhouettes in the foreground.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rendered with a 3D chiseled effect to appear engraved into the gold frame.

composition.position: Top center of the frame header
composition.scale: Small relative to the frame width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking for a prestigious, institutional feel.
graphicDevices: Ornate corner flourishes on the frame

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions with a modern, sharp finish.
The industry standard for 'monumental' or 'cinematic' serif engraving.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of 5 people in urban streetwear standing on a rocky shore in front of a large suspension bridge. Place this entire image inside a thick, ornate gold museum frame. The frame should be set in a dark gallery where the bottom third of the image is occupied by the black silhouettes of people's heads and shoulders looking up at the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name and title in the top center of the gold frame using an all-caps serif font. Apply a bevel and emboss effect to make the text look engraved into the metal.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered on the top bar of the frame?
Are the foreground silhouettes completely black with no detail?
Does the frame have a 3D metallic texture?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel 'premium'?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Type of bridge in the background
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on clothing
Ensure the bridge is a generic suspension bridge rather than a specific landmark if copyright is a concern

mustAchieve: Realistic metallic gold texture on the frame
Clear separation between the 'painting' and the 'gallery' space

postGenerationChecks: Check that the frame lighting matches the gallery environment.
Verify the text appears physically part of the frame.
Ensure the group's eye levels are consistent with the low-angle shot.
Confirm the silhouettes do not overlap the main subjects' faces.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take [Subject Group] + [Iconic Background] + [Ornate Gold Frame] + [Engraved Serif Text] + [Foreground Silhouettes] to create a 'Legacy Masterpiece' composition.
